title: This game is your elevator to English – level 2
paragraphs: What is LangoPlay? LangoPlay is like an elevator. It can take you up to an intermediate level of English. It helps you move from your current level to a level where you know about 2,500 words.
These 2,500 words are very important. They are 90% of everyday spoken English. At this level, you will know enough words and basic grammar to communicate in everyday situations.
So, how can you get there? Play LangoPlay every day. Complete one chapter each day and try to get all the stars.

In the Listening section, listen to the whole chapter many times. Listen until you understand it well. Then hide the left side of the Listening section and translate the text into your own language. Practice the translation many times until you can translate the whole text correctly.
Then move to the next chapter.

While you play, always focus on the meaning. Think about what you are reading, hearing, or saying. Imagine the people, places, and situations in your mind. This is important because it helps you remember new words for a longer time.
Try LangoPlay today. Start for free at langoplay.com.
